saw.said on HYPOTHESES.md: The first version had 71 entries and was written to be thorough. It reached 127 within a single afternoon, and every addition came from an analogy raised in passing — soil sickness, desertification, sandy deserts, compost going anaerobic, turfgrass thatch, replant disease.
